description: Explore, a diagnostic only, run outside the official command and the timed region, with no recipe change. After training on dev seeds 3-7 (5 trials), compute un-augmented top-1 accuracy and mean loss on a fixed 10k training subset (drawn with a fixed generator) for two configs: the current tip and E038 (head scale 1x). Test accuracy is logged as usual. Nothing is kept. This tells us whether the head-scale gain came from better fit or less over-regularization, and whether the recipe under-fits (margin from steps or capacity) or has a large gap (margin from regularization).
